issues.description: The problem statement UML and the solution expect Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), but the template's Meal constructor has the parameters in the opposite order (Meal(String[] ingredients, String name)). This mismatch also makes the example usage in Main (which calls new Meal("name", new String[]{...})) inconsistent with the template constructor, which will confuse students about the correct constructor signature to implement and use.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template Meal constructor to match the UML and solution by changing its signature to public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients) and assign fields accordingly. Also update any example usages in Main (currently using Meal("name", new String[]{...})) to match if necessary. This ensures consistency between problem statement, template examples, and solution.
